name: Podcast Search by Listen Notes
tagline: Search podcasts, research guests, and discover PR leads
description: Search podcasts and episodes, research guest interviews, find available producer contacts, and check podcast descriptions for mentions of a person, brand, or topic. The hosted, read-only Listen Notes MCP server uses OAuth to connect a Podcast API account. Podcast API requests use the selected app's existing plan and billing; some fields and endpoints require PRO or ENTERPRISE access.

install.notes: Choose OAuth and leave the OAuth client ID blank so Cline can register automatically. Sign in to Listen Notes and select a Podcast API app when prompted. MCP is free; Podcast API usage follows the selected app's plan and billing.
